Commentary.Commentary: That’s it then from this game! Bangladesh have sealed their progression which means the Netherlands have been knocked out. Just the two games from the Group Stage left before the Super 8s begin. Until then, goodbye and take care.

The skipper of Bangladesh, Najmul Hossain Shanto says that they are very happy with how they played the group stage. Hopes to continue this bowling performance. Shares that the belief was there that they could defend the total if they picked early wickets. Adds that they have a good variety in their bowling unit and that is why they have excelled in this format. Feels that momentum is important in T20s and hopes to build on it.

The captain of Nepal, Rohit Paudel says the bowlers did really well. Batting could have been better but Bangladesh bowled really well. Admits they lost too many wickets in the first 6 overs but they fought back well. Ends by saying they need to step up as a batting unit and assess the wicket a lot better. Also says the team has great potential and he hopes to do better going ahead.

Tanzim Hasan Sakib is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his stellar showing with the ball. He says they just wanted to bowl in the good areas and just wanted to defend this total. Adds everyone bowled well and hence, they managed to defend this. Says he was only focusing on his plan and it came well. Also adds they are confident heading into the Super 8s. Ends by saying the widket is not easy, you just have to bowl the right lines and lengths.
Time for the presentation ceremony...

Nepal then fought back courtesy of Kushal Malla and Dipendra Singh Airee. They really got their side back into the game. It came down to them needing 30 in 24. However, the Fizz yet again came to the fore for his side. He gave away just the 1 run in the 17th and got the wicket of Malla and in the 19th, it was even better, he got Airee and bowled a maiden. Shakib Al Hasan then bowled the last over and picked two in two to seal the game.

Yet another nail-biter of a game! Bangladesh in the end have prevailed and have sealed their progress into the Super 8s. Tanzim Hasan Sakib at the start and Mustafizur Rahman at the end were absolutely brilliant. Tanzim ran through the top order as he got 4 in no time. He bowled 4 in a row and got 4 massive wickets.

OUT! PLUMB IN FRONT! Two in two for Shakib Al Hasan to finish things off! Bangladesh are through to the Super 8s. Pushes it through, on a nagging length and it skids through, on middle, Abinash Bohara gets on the back foot and gets inside the line to work it away with the angle. He fails to get any bat on it and it goes through to trap him right in front of the stumps. Up goes the finger but Abinash Bohara takes the review, more in hope than anything else. There is nothing on UltraEdge and it is three reds on Ball Tracking. Nepal have been bowled out for 85 and this is the lowest total ever defended by a team in Men's T20 World Cups.

Commentary.Commentary: Good heat! A short one on the body. Rohit looks to pull but misses.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Taskin Ahmed to Rohit Paudel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Half a chance! Need to hang onto everything when you are behind the game. Length and around off. Aasif looks to defend, this goes off the outside edge to the right of widish first slip. He dives, it hits his hand and goes down to third man. One taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Taskin Ahmed to Aasif Sheikh, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! That is a lovely shot! A little too full and put away! Fuller and on off. Aasif drills it down the ground and to the long off fence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Taskin Ahmed to Aasif Sheikh, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! A little too wide! Outside off. Shorter. Aasif looks to cut but misses.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Taskin Ahmed to Aasif Sheikh, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Good length again and on off. Blocked well. Uh oh, it is heating up out there. Some words being exchanged between Tanzim Hasan Sakib and Rohit Paudel and the two umpires converge to calm things down.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Rohit Paudel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! Length and around off. Kept out.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Rohit Paudel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Rohit Paudel walks out to bat now.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! Two in the over for Tanzim Hasan Sakib and this is just the start Bangladesh needed. Tanzim bowls this on a length and gets a little bit of away shape, on off, Anil Sah tries to launch it down the ground but gets it off the toe-end of the bat and it skies up high in the air towards mid off where Najmul Hossain Shanto settles under it and does the rest.
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Tanzim Hasan Sakib
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Anil Sah, OUT! c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Tanzim Hasan Sakib.

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, that took off! Hits the hard length, on off, Anil Sah gets taken aback by the extra bounce and it rears off to hit him on the shoulder. Tanzim walks up and he has a few words for Sah. He is all charged up.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Anil Sah, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Anil Sah is in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Tanzim Hasan Sakib gets a wicket off a full toss but he won't mind one bit! Kushal Bhurtel stands there in disbelief. Goes searching for swing and tries to go full, at the stumps, it swings away late in the air. Kushal Bhurtel stays leg side of the ball to drive it down the ground. It zips past the outside edge and just clips the off-stump to knock the bails off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Kushal Bhurtel, OUT! b Tanzim Hasan Sakib.

Commentary.Commentary: Hurls it on a hard length and tucks the batter up for room, Kushal Bhurtel tries to keep it out but fails to negotiate the bounce and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Kushal Bhurtel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Ungainly but effective! Angling in, on a back of a length, on middle, Aasif Sheikh sets deep in his crease and swipes across the line. Gets it off the inner half of the bat, behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Taskin Ahmed to Aasif Sheikh, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Big swing and a miss! Lands it on a good length, outside off, Aasif Sheikh shimmies across a bit and swings to go over mid on but fails to connect with thin air.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Taskin Ahmed to Aasif Sheikh, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Continues to get steep bounce does Taskin from a back of a length, on middle, Aasif Sheikh hops and stabs it down the deck.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Taskin Ahmed to Aasif Sheikh, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Ouch, Aasif Sheikh has copped a blow on the helmet! Taskin Ahmed bends his back and delivers a sharp and quick bumper that takes off from the deck, Aasif Sheikh gets rushed and fails to get out of the way quickly enough. The ball climbs onto him and hits him flush on the helmet. Aasif passes the concussion check and he is ready to continue.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Taskin Ahmed to Aasif Sheikh, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: And again! On a back of a length, angling in, at the batter, Aasif Sheikh looks to defend but the ball hits the splice of the bat and dies down on the leg side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Taskin Ahmed to Aasif Sheikh, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Taskin charges in from over the wicket and hits the hard length, gets extra bounce as well, on off, Aasif Sheikh gets rapped on the gloves as he looks to keep it out.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Taskin Ahmed to Aasif Sheikh, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Who will bowl from the other end? It will be Taskin Ahmed.
Hurls it in a good length, closer to the off-stump line, Kushal Bhurtel shuffles across to cover the line of the ball but the ball moves away just enough to beat the bat.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Kushal Bhurtel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: This keeps swinging away, full and near the tramline on off, Kushal Bhurtel plays well away from his body but fails get any bat on it.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Kushal Bhurtel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Serves it on a length, in the corridor off, Kushal Bhurtel gets on the front foot and pushes it out to cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Kushal Bhurtel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten again! In the channel on off, fuller in length, shaping away, Kushal Bhurtel reaches out for the drive and goes chasing after it. He is lucky not to nick this one behind.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Kushal Bhurtel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Full and swinging way, way outside the guideline on off. Wided.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Kushal Bhurtel, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: That jagged back in a long way! Delivers it on a good length and it skids through, on off, Kushal Bhurtel looks to get on the front foot to play it past the bowler but gets cut in half as the ball nips back in to beat him on the inside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Kushal Bhurtel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Edged away! A streaky start to the Nepal chase! Tanzim Hasan Sakib steams in from over the wicket and bangs it on a hard length, angling in, on middle, Kushal Bhurtel looks to play at it but it nips back in and catches the inside edge. It races down to fine leg for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Tanzim Hasan Sakib to Kushal Bhurtel, Four!
